header.title: How to Install a Washer and Dryer
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions for installing a new washer and dryer, covering plumbing, gas connections (if applicable), electrical work, and venting.

steps.description: This step instructs the user to purchase a washer and dryer, considering delivery and installation options.
actions: Choose the right washer and dryer
Consider delivery options from appliance stores
Consider paying for professional installation

steps.description: Install hot and cold water lines with shut-off valves and a water hammer arrester if needed for new appliance locations.
actions: Run hot- and cold-water lines to the appliances
Terminate the lines with shut-off valves
Install a water hammer arrester between the shut-off valve and the incoming water supply
Check water pressure with a water pressure gauge
steps.part: Water lines, shut-off valves, water hammer arrester

steps.description: Position the washer and dryer, ensuring a level surface and proper connection reach for hoses and cords.
actions: Get help positioning the washer and dryer.
Ensure the placement location is completely flat.
Use a level to check for flatness.
Adjust the washer’s feet to ensure it stays level.
Verify hose connections can safely reach their sources.
Verify cords can safely reach their sources.
Ensure hoses and vents reach their source without straining or restricting water or airflow.

steps.description: Before installation, disconnect power to the washer and dryer by switching off the appropriate circuit breakers.
actions: Cut off the power
Locate the circuit breakers
Switch off the 110V breaker to the washer
Switch off the 220V breaker to the dryer (if not gas setup)

steps.description: Connect the hoses to the outlet valves, securing them with silicone tape and ensuring proper hot and cold connections, and connecting any water-suppression valve as directed.
actions: Attach hoses to outlet valves
Observe hot and cold connections
Secure with silicone tape
Connect water-suppression valve (if applicable)
Refer to owner's manual for water-suppression valve connection

steps.description: This step describes how to connect the washer's drainpipe, either by hooking it over an existing laundry sink or installing a standpipe.
actions: Hook the washer's drainpipe over the edge of an existing laundry sink (if available)
Use a standpipe if no laundry sink is present
Attach the standpipe to an existing drain system
Purchase a standpipe from a plumbing outlet
Build a standpipe from scratch
steps.part: drainpipe, standpipe, drain system, laundry sink

steps.description: Install a trap if a standpipe is required, positioning the standpipe and trap at specific heights.
actions: Install a trap
Use a standpipe if needed
Position the standpipe 18-30 inches above the trap
Position the trap 6-8 inches above floor level

steps.description: This step involves powering on the washing machine and checking for leaks after installation.
actions: Plug the washer in
Turn on the circuit breaker to the washer
Ensure the water valves are on
Turn on the machine to begin filling the washer
Check for any leaks

steps.description: Connect the gas supply to the shut-off valve and then to the dryer, using silicone tape for added security.
actions: Shut off breakers and gas valve
Connect the gas supply to the shut-off valve
Use silicone tape for extra security
Connect the flexible gas supply line to the dryer

steps.description: Check the gas fitting for leaks by applying a soapy water solution and observing for bubbles.
actions: Brush a 50-to-50 ratio of liquid detergent and water on the gas fitting.
Turn the gas at the main gas shut-off valve.
Observe gas connections for bubbles.
Ensure the fitting is tight if bubbles are present.
Turn off the gas again.

steps.description: Connect the dryer to a vent outlet using metal ducting and secure the connections with screws and duct tape.
actions: Attach a metal-ducting pipe to the dryer.
Use appropriate lengths to reach the outlet.
Attach all elbows and fittings with sheet-metal screws.
Wrap the connections with duct tape.

steps.description: Attach the power cord to the dryer, following instructions for electric dryer installation, and then test the dryer.
actions: Attach the power cord
Follow directions for 'Installing an Electric Dryer'
Plug in the power cord
Turn on the gas
Turn on the electric
Test the dryer

steps.description: Determine the type of electrical outlet in the laundry room and purchase a compatible power cord for the dryer.
actions: Determine which outlet your laundry room has
Purchase the appropriate cord

steps.description: Ensure the power to the dryer's outlet is turned off before installation.
actions: make sure the power is off

steps.description: This step details how to install a four-prong cord by connecting the wires and securing the ground wire to the dryer.
actions: If you have a three-prong cord, move on to the next step.
Connect the white, black, and red cord wires to the corresponding wires on the dryer.
Attach the green ground wire to the dryer’s green ground screw.
Remove any copper strap or green wire running from the ground screw to the white dryer wire.

steps.description: Connect a three-prong cord to the dryer by matching wires according to the instructions.
actions: Connect the dryer’s red wire to either of the outside wires.
Connect the other outside wire to the black wire.
Connect the center wire to the white dryer wire.
Connect the center wire to the ground strap that’s attached to the ground screw.

steps.description: Attach the vent hose to the vent duct and the dryer’s port using hose clamps.
actions: Attach vent hose to vent duct
Attach vent hose to dryer’s port
steps.part: Vent hose, vent duct, dryer’s port

steps.description: Plug in the dryer, turn the power back on, and test to ensure it functions correctly.
actions: Plug in the dryer
Turn the power back on
Test the electric dryer
